title: Feather Ornament
text: “Motoyasu, pull yourself together!”
Before I knew it, my father had me in a bear hug from behind. Why on earth am I being held down by my father?
“Motoyasu, you’re way stronger than me, so it’s a real problem when you lose your cool!”
For some reason, my father seems to be in a bad mood—in a way that feels strangely familiar.
“Oh? Why am I being held down by my father?”
“Didn’t you just lunge at the Filolial that appeared? And to top it off, you clung to it while letting out a strange cry of ‘Great Filolial-sama!’…”
“That was a blunder, wasn’t it? But I simply couldn’t help myself.”
“Sigh…”
My Father blindfolded me as I calmed down. My vision is blocked—it’s pitch black. But I can still sense the presence and scent of Filolial-sama all around me…
“Why are you blindfolding me, Father?”
“Motoyasu, don’t you remember? Just when I thought you’d regained your senses, you went and lunged at that Great Filolial… the legendary Filolial, again.”
“Seriously… Mr. Kitamura, please control yourself. Now, Yuki, what purpose have these people gathered here for?”
“I’m told they’ve come to challenge us to a battle.”
“Hmm… Is it to have us acknowledge their strength? Lord Kitamura, you seem to have an idea about this—do you know anything?”
“I believe my future Father mentioned it. By acknowledging their strength, one gains the qualification to succeed Filolial-sama.”
“Is this some sort of generational succession ritual?”

Exactly. Filolial-sama is the Filolial among Filolials. You could say she is the one who reigns at the very pinnacle of the Filolials. If we consider Filo-tan and Yuki-chan to be the Queens of the Filolials, then she is the true Queen. Moreover, being recognized by Filolial-sama isn’t just about status.
“At the same time, you’ll be granted a special Class Up.”
“What? If that’s the case, I can expect a boost in combat power. It wouldn’t be a bad idea to give it a try, would it?”
“More importantly, Father, please take off the blindfold. I want to throw my arms around Filolial-sama right this very moment!”
“Um… Motoyasu-kun, I’m sorry.”
Huh? My Father just covered my ears. Oh well. I’ll just pick up on the faint sounds I can still hear.
“Thanks to Lord Iwatani holding Lord Kitamura down, the legendary Filolial didn’t escape. Yuki, Kou, Sakura—each of you, go challenge it to a fight.”
“If getting stronger means Motoyasu will acknowledge me, then I’ll do my best.”
“Sounds fun! I’ll do my best!”
“As for Sakura, I’d be happy just if I could protect everyone…?”
“You can’t protect everyone unless you get stronger, right? It seems all you have to do is prove your strength, so do your best.”
“Got it—”
It seems my Father has convinced Sakura-chan. However, I can’t see a thing like this. This Motoyasu here wants to throw all reason to the wind and dive right at the great Filolial-sama.
“So, let’s take turns. Why don’t we start with Yuki-chan?”
“Understood.”

After that, I couldn’t make out what was said. Soon, a sound that seemed to make the air vibrate echoed repeatedly. Since it was my Father’s order, I, Motoyasu, desperately suppressed the urge to look and endured what felt like an eternity. And then… just as I was starting to doze off, my Father removed the blindfold. The Filolial-sama were already nowhere to be seen. Looking around, I saw Yuki and the others collapsed on the ground, looking completely exhausted.
“That was intense, wasn’t it?”
“Yeah, Yuki and the others put up a good fight. Still, that legendary Filolial was just too strong.”
“I wonder who Motoyasu-kun really is—the very person that Filolial tried to flee from without a second glance…”
“Don’t say that. It makes me feel empty.”
I ran over to Yuki and the others to check on them. It doesn’t look like they need any healing magic. They all have crown feathers on their heads.

“Sakura-chan translated it for me. Apparently, the legendary Filolial—Ms. Fitoria?—recognizes everyone as potential successors. She said that eventually, the one among them who shows the most promise… the one with the noblest aspirations… will be the one to succeed her.”
“The great Filolial-sama…”
“Motoyasu-kun, you like that girl Filo, don’t you? You can’t do that. You can’t cheat on her.”
“But there’s no comparison, you know. My future Father said it’s okay for me to get along with anyone other than Filo-tan.”
“Did I just encourage cheating!?”
“I, Motoyasu, intend to make all the Filolial-samas equally happy. This isn’t cheating at all. Filo-tan is number one. The Great Filolial-sama comes in second, and the rest are Filolial-samas.”
“If you don’t call that cheating… Never mind. Dealing with Lord Kitamura is exhausting. Yuki, you need to work on your feminine charms so Lord Kitamura will even notice you.”
“Yes… Lady Eclair.”
Yuki-chan staggered to her feet and nodded.
“I’m totally wiped—but it was fun!”
Kou replied cheerfully, while Sakura-chan was snoring away.
“Ah… Sakura-chan. If you sleep in that position, you’ll wake up with a stiff neck.”

Father gently shook Sakura-chan awake. It was a great pity, but the outcome turned out to be different from when I, Motoyasu, encountered Filolial-sama with Kuu and the others. It seems Yuki-chan and the others’ abilities have improved.
“Oh, Motoyasu-kun. Ms. Fitoria gave me this as a souvenir.”
My father gave me one of the Great Filolial-sama’s crest feathers. Without hesitation, I sniffed the feather.
“No… that’s not it. Apparently, if you insert it into a weapon, it unlocks the Filolial series.”
“What?!”

This is the method for collecting the Filolial series that my future father never told me about. But how infuriating. If I put such a magnificent treasure into my spear, I might never be able to get my hands on it again. Sure, if I loop back in time, I might be able to obtain it again… but this Motoyasu—I simply cannot bring myself to put this feather into my spear.
“...You’re not going to put it in?”
“I’m going to keep it as a treasure.”

After taking a deep sniff, I’ll attach it as a feather ornament to the tang—the part between the spear shaft and the ferrule. This way, I can feel as though I’m fighting alongside Filolial-sama. Above all, it’s a feather given to me by the great Filolial-sama herself. It will surely become a source of strength to protect me, my Father, and everyone else.
Besides, if my Father has been collecting them as part of a series, there’s no point in me using one. As a comrade, it will surely boost Yuki-chan and the others’ growth.
“Motoyasu-kun… I’ve thought this many times before, but you’re amazing in so many ways. I’ve never felt it as strongly as I do today.”
“That’s true.”
“Yes.”
Eclair and the envoy from Siltvelt nodded at Father’s words. Did I do something strange? It was striking how Father and the others let out sighs.
And so, the carriage drawn by Yuki-chan and the others—now stronger than ever—pressed on toward Siltvelt. Around here, monsters appear that have never been pierced by a spear.
“Well, well, Shield Hero, Spear Hero!”
In the town we stopped at, a large group of Demi-Humans came out to greet us.
“We’ve come from Siltvelt to welcome you, Heroes. It must have been a grueling journey. Come, let’s head to our country together.”
Escorted by dozens of Demi-Humans and Beastmen, we set off. Father looked uneasy as he watched the Siltvelt army accompanying us from inside the carriage.
“Lord Iwatani, I understand how you feel, but please calm down.”
“I-I know, but… just think about what would happen if we were attacked by a group this size… you know?”
“True, I’ve lost count of how many times we’ve been ambushed on this journey. Messenger, can we trust them?”
“Yes. There’s no problem. Though it is a bit unsettling that we haven’t heard from Shieldfreeden…”
It’s important to stay vigilant. But we can’t make any progress if we’re just on guard all the time.
“If anything happens, this Motoyasu will wipe them all out.”
And so, after joining forces with the Siltvelt army, we were able to enter Siltvelt safely.
“Speaking of which, when is the Wave coming?”
“The Melromarc Wave… I think it’s about a week from now?”
“Huh… So it was pretty dangerous, wasn’t it? You get summoned to the site of the Wave, right?”
It certainly was dangerous.
“There was one place in one of the countries along the way. If I’m to go by what Lord Kitamura said, I think we should have registered there.”
“There was? Then shouldn’t we have stopped by to help Yuki-chan and the others with Class Up?”
“Making a detour is risky in many ways. After all, it’s not like there weren’t any assassins, and we can’t rule out the possibility that traps had been set.”
“I-I see.”
“Besides, the Dragon Hourglass has a ritual called ‘Class Up.’ We wouldn’t know what would happen if we did Class Up in a country we couldn’t trust.”
“I see… So? Is that available in Siltvelt, too?”
“That’s what I’ve heard, but I’m not exactly an expert on that. The language is different, too—I can manage everyday conversation, but…”

Come to think of it, the Hero’s weapon did have a translation function. I didn’t learn Siltvelt’s script from my Father, so I can’t read it. I can manage everyday conversation, but written communication would be difficult.

I suddenly glance outside the carriage. Hmm… I can’t quite put my finger on it, but a dense forest and Chinese-style buildings catch my eye. The impression of a “wild” country fits perfectly. It seems there are even Demi-Humans who can fly; compared to Melromarc, there certainly seem to be quite a few differences.
“So, when is the next wave in Siltvelt supposed to happen?”
“I’ve heard that the last wave occurred two weeks after the one in Melromarc.”
The envoy from Siltvelt explained.
“So that means there was a Wave around the time we were summoned, huh?”
The envoy is talking with the Demi-Humans outside the carriage. Then he turned his face toward my Father.
“It’s estimated that Siltvelt’s next Wave will occur in three weeks.”
“Three weeks, huh… It’ll depend on how much stronger we can get by then.”
“That’s true, but Lord Iwatani, you might be required to make various public appearances for official duties, you know?”
